invented.quote: You and up to three others play as a lighthouse keeper's family.
invented.why: The brief says players 'see a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter', not that they play as the family members.

invented.quote: I've spent three years making that goal worth fighting for.
invented.why: The brief only states that playtesting has happened 'since 2023' and gives no current year or total duration of development.

invented.quote: That's 140 times I've watched people play it and then gone back to fix whatever didn't work.
invented.why: The brief only says 140 playtest sessions were run, not that the designer watched every session and made fixes after each one.

invented.quote: On BoardGameGeek, the 23 people who have rated it so far give it an average of **8.1 out of 10**.
invented.why: The brief refers only to 'the main board game ratings site' and an average rating of 8.1, without naming BoardGameGeek or a 10-point scale.
The brief states the creator hasn't 'published a game before' and that this is their first campaign, not that this is the first game they have ever designed.

invented.quote: Getting a copy to a backer in the US costs about $9.
invented.why: The brief says shipping to backers would cost about $9 a copy, without specifying that this $9 cost to the creator is only for US backers.

invented.quote: $28,000, built on those figures rather than a guess.
invented.why: The brief states the $28,000 goal and the printing/shipping quotes separately, without stating how the goal was calculated.

invented.quote: If we reach $28,000, the game goes to the factory. If we don't, it stays a prototype on my table.
invented.why: The brief does not state that the campaign uses all-or-nothing funding or that the creator has no other way to print the game if the goal is not met.
